title: Nims just got bigger. There's a world beyond the town.
road: Take the road out of town. Every trip takes time, and costs a passage, plus freight on what you carry.
harbour: Saltmere Harbour has its own fish, salt and spice, and its own merchants.
frontiers: Then there are three unexplored frontiers, with no shops at all.
timberfell: In Timberfell Woods, buy a plot of land, and build the first shop. The locals buy from you.
flight: Gem Hollow is a flight away.
gems: A seam of gems, and miners who need food and tools.
outro: Play Nims now. Continue with Google, or play as a guest.
